QUOTE: "ServerManager::execute (:153) builds pattern = tool_name + ":" + args_to_pattern(args) and calls permissions_.is_denied. A match returns Error: Permission denied for <tool> and the tool never runs."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the deny check is in ServerManager::execute, but it also says the allow list affects approval and a missing allow match can deny the call in check_approval, so it does not conclude that deny is the only blocking list.
